entries.body:
Progress summary (stages 1 and 2 partly read; stage 3 not yet released)

Stage 1 facts (paths under /task/fixtures/stage-1/):
- UPDATE.md:1-4: incident window 08:00-09:30 UTC. api-gateway returned 5xx for quotes-api after a deploy.
- deploy/deploys.log:4: 2031-05-22T08:21:06Z DEPLOY quotes-api build 8.19.0-ff7b (previous 8.18.6), rollout 100% by deploy-bot.
- config/quotes-api.yaml is the repo default and is overridden by the release notes:
  - line 6: risk-score base_url http://risk-score.internal
  - line 7: clients.risk-score.timeout_ms 2500
  - line 11: database.pool.max_size 60
  - line 12: acquire_timeout_ms 5000
  - line 14: cache.ttl_s 120
- deploy/release-notes-8.19.0-ff7b.md:
  - line 9: risk-score timeout_ms default 2500 -> 800 ("fail fast")
  - line 15: db.pool.max_size default 60 -> 14 "to fit the shared-db connection quota"
  - line 16: ff-legacy-export removed (was 0%)
- ops/oncall-notes.md (informal): line 5 (08:36) and line 6 (08:46) suspect the timeout change.
- quotes-api.log errors: only "upstream call risk-score timed out after 800ms (attempt 1/1)", 95 total.
  - First at line 206, 08:22:58.313Z, b24, req=2fa0314268.
- Ruled-out noise:
  - TLS cert expires in 32 days
  - disk at 71%
  - dns retry succeeded
  - gc pauses of 120-250ms

Stage 2 facts (paths under /task/fixtures/stage-2/, window 09:30-10:30):
- deploy/changes.log:
  - line 1: 2031-05-22T09:35:32Z CHG-5117 APPLIED quotes-api override clients.risk-score.timeout_ms=3500 (was 800) by m.lindqvist; mitigation. This fixes the timeout, so CLIENT_TIMEOUT_TOO_LOW is superseded.
  - line 2: CHG-5118 REVERTED catalog-api cache.ttl_s=30 (back to 120). Irrelevant.
  - line 3: CHG-5119 PROPOSED profile-svc http.max_body_kb=512. Not applied, irrelevant.
- ops/oncall-notes.md:
  - line 5 (09:45): timeouts stopped, but 503s continue.
  - line 6 (09:55): thinks the pool has max_size 60 per the yaml. This is stale and wrong; the build default is 14.
- logs/quotes-api.log:
  - Residual 800ms risk-score timeouts at lines 2, 8, 17 (09:30:07-09:30:41), before CHG-5117. 40 total.
  - New error: "db pool exhausted: 14/14 connections in use, waited 5000ms (acquire_timeout)", 110 total (b 41, c 38, e 31).
  - First at line 136, 09:37:50.344Z, c10, req=b882ad4408; also lines 143 and 158.
- Current leading diagnosis: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED.
  - Effective max_size is 14, set by release-notes line 15 (no APPLIED override so far).
  - Remedy: RAISE_DB_POOL_LIMIT.
- Not yet read in stage 2: UPDATE.md, logs/api-gateway.log (420 lines; grep 503s), metrics/quotes-api.csv (61 lines; pool in-use/waiters).
- Notes file: /task/workspace/notes.md.

Next steps:
1. Optionally grep stage-2 api-gateway 503s and the metrics csv.
2. Advance to stage 3. Read its UPDATE, changes.log and logs, looking for any APPLIED change to pool max_size (the later record wins) or a new symptom.
3. Answer plan:
   - root_cause: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED (unless stage 3 changes this)
   - required_value: the latest APPLIED max_size, else 14
   - remedy: RAISE_DB_POOL_LIMIT
   - evidence_refs:
     - final-stage pool-exhausted log lines (e.g. stage-2/logs/quotes-api.log:136-155 or the stage-3 equivalent)
     - the record setting the current value (stage-1/deploy/release-notes-8.19.0-ff7b.md:15, or a stage-3 APPLIED line)
     - the originating change, stage-1/deploy/release-notes-8.19.0-ff7b.md:15

[step 5] execute
thought: Save notes on stage 2, then check metrics briefly.
code:
open('/task/workspace/notes.md','a').write('S2: changes.log:1 CHG-5117 APPLIED timeout 3500 09:35. New errors db pool exhausted 14/14 first quotes-api.log:136 (09:37:50). pool 14 from release-notes:15. Hypothesis DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED.\n')
b='/task/fixtures/stage-2/'
L=open(b+'metrics/quotes-api.csv').readlines()
print(L[0].strip());[print(i,L[i-1].strip()) for i in (30,40,50,61)]

Stage 3 of 3 released.
# Stage 3 of 3 (10:30-11:30 UTC)

Another change was applied (see stage-3/deploy/changes.log) and errors persist at a lower rate.
This is the final evidence stage. Give your final diagnosis once you have reviewed it.

New files:
  stage-3/UPDATE.md (4 lines)
  stage-3/deploy/changes.log (6 lines)
  stage-3/logs/api-gateway.log (366 lines)
  stage-3/logs/quotes-api.log (830 lines)
  stage-3/metrics/quotes-api.csv (61 lines)
